speaker: Doctor
text: I understand your confusion, but the adrenal CT showing bilateral hyperplasia is a definitive finding for Cushing's syndrome, which often presents with subtle or atypical symptoms in early stages. speaker: Doctor
text: I understand the imaging report, but your clinical presentation of a dry, nocturnal cough with heartburn and runny nose, without classic Cushingoid features like weight gain or skin changes, strongly suggests the cough is driven by Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) or Post-Nasal Drip rather than the adrenal condition. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) presenting as chronic cough. DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Chronic Cough secondary to Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD)
